Soapy moved restlessly on his bench in Madison Square, for winter was coming to New York. <break time="0.8s" /> A dead leaf fell into his lap, and Soapy knew it was the card of Jack Frost. <break time="0.8s" /> Jack Frost was kind to the people who lived in the park, for he always sent a warning before his yearly visit. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy knew that the time had come for him to make his plans for the hard winter. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy did not dream of a trip to the warm Mediterranean Sea or the sunny southern skies. <break time="0.8s" /> All he wanted was three months on the Island, where he would have food, a bed, and good company. <break time="0.8s" /> If he were in prison for the winter, he would not have to fear the cold wind or the police. <break time="0.8s" /> Many kind groups in the city gave beds and food to the poor, but Soapy did not want their charity. <break time="0.8s" /> In return for a bed, they asked many questions about his private life, which hurt his pride. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy decided that the law was kinder than charity, so he would let the law take care of him.

소피는 불안하게 몸을 뒤척였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 매디슨 스퀘어의 벤치에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 뉴욕에 겨울이 다가오고 있었기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙엽 하나가 그의 무릎 위로 떨어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 소피는 알았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것이 잭 프로스트의 명함이라는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 잭 프로스트는 사람들에게 친절했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 공원에서 지내는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 늘 미리 알려 주었기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 해마다 찾아오기 전에. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 때가 왔다는 것을 알았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자신이 계획을 세워야 할. <break time="0.8s" /> 혹독한 겨울을 대비해. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 여행을 꿈꾸지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 따뜻한 지중해로 가는. <break time="0.8s" /> 또는 햇살 가득한 남쪽 하늘로 가는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 원한 것은 석 달뿐이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 섬에서 보내는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳에는 먹을 것이 있을 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 잠자리와 좋은 벗도 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 감옥에 있다면. <break time="0.8s" /> 겨울 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 두려워할 필요가 없을 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 차가운 바람도 경찰도. <break time="0.8s" /> 도시의 여러 자선 단체가. <break time="0.8s" /> 가난한 사람들에게 잠자리와 음식을 주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 소피는 그들의 자선을 원하지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 잠자리를 주는 대가로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 많은 질문을 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 사생활에 대해. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것이 그의 자존심을 상하게 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 결론을 내렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 법이 자선보다 더 친절하다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그는 법에게 맡길 생각이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자신을 돌보는 일을.

Soapys first idea was to eat a fine dinner. <break time="0.8s" /> At an expensive restaurant. <break time="0.8s" /> And then say that he had no money. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he would be handed quietly. <break time="0.8s" /> To a policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> And a judge would send him. <break time="0.8s" /> To the Island. <break time="0.8s" /> He walked into a bright café on Broadway. <break time="0.8s" /> Where rich people enjoyed. <break time="0.8s" /> The finest food and wine. <break time="0.8s" /> His face was shaved. <break time="0.8s" /> And his coat was neat. <break time="0.8s" /> But his old trousers and broken shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> Told a different story. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing those trousers and shoes. <break time="0.8s" /> The head waiter quickly turned him around. <break time="0.8s" /> And pushed him out onto the street. <break time="0.8s" /> On Sixth Avenue. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy picked up a stone. <break time="0.8s" /> And threw it through a large shop window. <break time="0.8s" /> People came running. <break time="0.8s" /> Around the corner. <break time="0.8s" /> With a policeman leading the crowd. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy stood still. <break time="0.8s" /> With his hands in his pockets. <break time="0.8s" /> And smiled at the policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> Waiting to be arrested. <break time="0.8s" /> The policeman asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had broken the window. <break time="0.8s" /> And Soapy said. <break time="0.8s" /> That he might have done it himself. <break time="0.8s" /> But the policeman believed. <break time="0.8s" /> That men who break windows. <break time="0.8s" /> Always run away. <break time="0.8s" /> So he ran after another man instead.

소피의 첫 번째 생각은 훌륭한 저녁을 먹는 것이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 비싼 식당에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그다음 돈이 없다고 말하는 것이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러면 그는 조용히 넘겨질 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 경찰관에게. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 판사가 그를 보내 줄 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 섬으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 브로드웨이의 화려한 카페로 걸어 들어갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳에서는 부자들이 즐기고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 최고급 음식과 포도주를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 면도를 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 외투도 단정했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 낡은 바지와 해진 구두는. <break time="0.8s" /> 다른 이야기를 하고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 바지와 구두를 보자. <break time="0.8s" /> 수석 웨이터는 재빨리 그를 돌려세웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그를 거리로 밀어냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 6번가에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 돌멩이 하나를 집어 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것을 커다란 가게 진열창으로 던졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람들이 달려왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 모퉁이를 돌아. <break time="0.8s" /> 경찰관이 무리 맨 앞에 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 가만히 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 두 손을 주머니에 넣은 채. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 경찰관에게 미소를 지었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 체포되기를 기다리면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 경찰관이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 누가 창문을 깼느냐고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 소피는 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어쩌면 자기가 그랬을지도 모른다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 경찰관은 믿었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 창문을 깨는 사람들은. <break time="0.8s" /> 언제나 달아난다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그는 대신 다른 남자를 쫓아갔다.

Next, Soapy went into a cheap restaurant. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the food was plain. <break time="0.8s" /> And the plates were thick. <break time="0.8s" /> He ate beefsteak, pancakes, doughnuts, and pie. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he told the waiter. <break time="0.8s" /> That he had no money. <break time="0.8s" /> Now, call a policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Soapy. <break time="0.8s" /> And do not keep a gentleman waiting. <break time="0.8s" /> Two waiters threw him out instead. <break time="0.8s" /> And he landed on his left ear. <break time="0.8s" /> On the hard sidewalk. <break time="0.8s" /> A policeman who stood nearby. <break time="0.8s" /> Only laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked away down the street. <break time="0.8s" /> After walking five blocks. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy found a young woman. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at a shop window. <break time="0.8s" /> With a large policeman standing near her. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy planned to bother her rudely. <break time="0.8s" /> Because he was sure. <break time="0.8s" /> That the policeman would arrest him for it. <break time="0.8s" /> He fixed his tie. <break time="0.8s" /> Coughed loudly. <break time="0.8s" /> And spoke to her boldly. <break time="0.8s" /> Glancing at the policeman again and again. <break time="0.8s" /> To his surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> The young woman happily took his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked him to buy her. <break time="0.8s" /> Something to drink. <break time="0.8s" /> At the next corner. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy shook off her arm and ran. <break time="0.8s" /> For it seemed. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was doomed to freedom.

다음으로 소피는 값싼 식당으로 들어갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 음식은 소박하고. <break time="0.8s" /> 접시는 두꺼운. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 비프스테이크, 팬케이크, 도넛, 파이를 먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 그는 웨이터에게 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 돈이 한 푼도 없다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 자, 경찰관을 부르시오. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 신사를 기다리게 하지 마시오. <break time="0.8s" /> 대신 웨이터 두 명이 그를 밖으로 내던졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 왼쪽 귀부터 떨어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 딱딱한 인도 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 근처에 서 있던 경찰관은. <break time="0.8s" /> 웃기만 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 거리를 따라 가 버렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다섯 블록을 걸어간 뒤. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 한 젊은 여자를 발견했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 가게 진열창을 들여다보고 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀 가까이에는 덩치 큰 경찰관이 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 그녀에게 무례하게 굴 작정이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 확신했기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 경찰관이 그 일로 자신을 체포할 것이라고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 넥타이를 고쳐 맸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 크게 헛기침을 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그녀에게 대담하게 말을 걸었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 경찰관을 몇 번이고 힐끗 보면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 놀랍게도. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 젊은 여자는 반갑게 그의 팔짱을 꼈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 사 달라고 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 마실 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음 모퉁이에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 소피는 그녀의 팔을 뿌리치고 달아났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아무래도. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 자유로울 수밖에 없는 운명인 것 같았다.

On a bright street full of theaters. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy began to shout, dance, and sing. <break time="0.8s" /> As loudly as he could. <break time="0.8s" /> The policeman only turned his back. <break time="0.8s" /> And told a man. <break time="0.8s" /> That Soapy was a college student celebrating a victory. <break time="0.8s" /> They are noisy but harmless. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And we have orders. <break time="0.8s" /> To leave them alone. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy stopped his useless noise. <break time="0.8s" /> In despair. <break time="0.8s" /> Wondering if he would ever reach the Island. <break time="0.8s" /> In a cigar store. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy saw a well dressed man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had left his silk umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> By the door. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy stepped inside. <break time="0.8s" /> Took the umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked slowly away. <break time="0.8s" /> And the man hurried after him. <break time="0.8s" /> That is my umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the man. <break time="0.8s" /> And Soapy told him to call the policeman. <break time="0.8s" /> Standing at the corner. <break time="0.8s" /> The man slowed down and said. <break time="0.8s" /> That he might have picked it up. <break time="0.8s" /> By mistake in a restaurant that morning. <break time="0.8s" /> If it is yours. <break time="0.8s" /> I hope you will excuse me. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And he hurried back into the cigar store. <break time="0.8s" /> Feeling angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Soapy threw the umbrella. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a hole in the road. <break time="0.8s" /> And complained about the police.
